description: Declaration of functions, templates, and classes for converting OpenGL state query values and types within the ANGLE project.

classes.name: GLTypeToGLenum
classes.description: Template struct for mapping GL types to GLenum values.

methods.name: CastMaskValue
methods.description: Converts a GLuint mask value to GLint.

methods.name: CastFromGLintStateValue
methods.description: Casts a GLint state value to a specific query type.

methods.name: CastFromStateValue
methods.description: Casts a native state value to a query type.

methods.name: CastQueryValueTo
methods.description: Converts a query type value to a native type.

methods.name: ConvertToGLenum
methods.description: Converts a parameter to GLenum based on its type.

methods.name: ConvertGLenum
methods.description: Casts a GLenum to a specified type.

methods.name: ConvertGLenumValue
methods.description: Converts a value to a GLenum and outputs it.

methods.name: ConvertPackedEnum
methods.description: Converts a packed enum type to a GLenum.

methods.name: CastStateValues
methods.description: Casts multiple state values from the context.

methods.name: CastIndexedStateValues
methods.description: Casts indexed state values from the context.
